segments.en:
...{..} But in our hearts we laughed at them {well}…

...A one-year-old child, my first child, passed away from hunger

How much weeping he wept: "Bread, bread, bread"

So, so it was, and he became no, no, what is it called?

He became like this, like a mountain, his body became like {a river} from hunger, yes

And he cried until he died: "Bread, bread, bread"

There will be what to tell, a story, what to tell, {what to speak}, about his people, about my people

Our holy Rabbainu said:

"There will be what to speak and what to tell about my people, who my people are"...

...Oy, I, and now I laugh, I cried, a one-year-old died by me from hunger

And he became swollen, swollen like a mountain from hunger

I do not exaggerate and I do not lie, chas v'shalom

This is still not, is not yet {...}, like a drop from the sea of what I suffered

{The name of} Breslov, we did not have women to marry {you}

All the women did not want, did not want Breslov

"What, Breslov, they need neither money nor honor nor anything, why get married?”…

...Now I laugh, but then I did not laugh

I suffered what there is no such thing in the world, such a death

{…}, such, such, such, there is not, there is not in the world, only, only for Breslov

Hunger was created only for Breslov, and all the troubles and suffering for Breslov

Let us see {..} what soldiers they are, they, what heroes they are…

...{…} I saw that he died every day, each and every day

Not only did he d.., he died at {six} years old

{Six} years, every day, every day he dies, every day he dies {.…}

And he suffered such hunger, hunger, "Bread, bread, bread, bread"…

...My father-in-law would beat Rebbe Yisroel, and tore out his beard, yes

"What is this? What do you want from my son-in-law? What is this? That he should be Breslov?
